newsitem.title: JAPAN: All Tokyo rubber futures end higher on weaker yen.
newsitem.headline: All Tokyo rubber futures end higher on weaker yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed higher in all months on Monday, reflecting the yen's weakness against the dollar, but are unlikely to rise sharply from their current levels, traders said.
Prices were 1.8 to 2.4 yen higher. The benchmark August contract ended up 2.1 yen at 153.6 yen per kg, after rising to 154.5 in late morning.

Buying by local investors, who were encouraged by the weaker yen, supported all contracts, traders said. Some months experienced technical selling in late afternoon, but sentiment remained bullish throughout the day, they said.
